B 仅踢第一只怪物;后续每一只怪物只有在前一具体身体接触后才倒下。冲击波强调局部接触,不会击倒未受接触的怪物。

0.0–3.0s — 蹬墙起跳与空中斩击
直接从动作中段开始。A 从建筑外立面蹬墙飞出,横穿十字路口,身后留下青色轨迹,起跳点爆裂出混凝土碎屑。

第一只怪物挥拳,A 扭身避过拳锋,在其上半身挥出一记巨大的青色月牙斩击。
需展现接触、火花与压力波纹。怪物踉跄但仍站立;连锁反应尚未开始。
A 在指定时间窗口内说出开场台词。
她降落在近侧十字路口,短暂滑行,站稳后开始为刀蓄力。青色光芒在未变形的金属刀刃上汇聚。
B 准备加速冲向战场。
3.0–5.0s — 紫色冲刺与回旋踢
全身侧面视角跟踪 B。
她低姿态沿道路加速,身后留下紫色轨迹与水雾,随后以一脚撑地,借助紫色能量跃向第一只怪物的胸口。
整个跳跃过程需连续呈现。
一记受控的回旋踢:躯干旋转,一条腿伸展,另一条保持弯曲。
她的脚跟在约4.5秒处明确击中胸口。短暂放慢这一接触瞬间,保持脚部与目标轮廓清晰。
一道巨大的紫色压力环从怪物背部后方爆开;附近窗户碎裂。当怪物上半身猛然向后甩向第二只怪物时恢复速度。
它是“撞入”队列,而不是“越过”队列。
B 向近侧十字路口反弹回撤,落点靠近 A。
5.0–8.5s — 怪物之间的连锁碰撞
沿大街的侧斜角跟踪运镜。
第一只怪物在可见重量下先向后倾倒;其上背部在第二只倒下之前击中第二只怪物的胸口。
局部空气环与低频冲击声强调接触。第二只撞上第三只,第三只撞上第四只,沿队列依次推进。
在第一次明确碰撞后,节奏需加快。镜头沿链条平移,展示下一只怪物在接触前仍保持直立。
倒下的躯体砸碎路旁的空楼。立面开裂、钢筋弯折、楼板断裂、沥青在每次坠落点翻起。
大量碎片向外爆裂。扬尘之上,身体接触需始终可见。
每一次连锁倒下均由身体碰撞引发。

升至高位斜俯视广角镜头。
剩余怪物依次倒下;最后一只在远处建筑间坠落,扬起最大规模的碎片烟尘。
整支队列被击败,展示其连续的破坏路径。
两位女主角作为独立的小剪影,保持在完好的近侧十字路口。
A 的蓄力光效持续可见:她那未释放的终结技仍在累积。
11.0–12.5s — 准备得太迟
稳定的中景双人镜头:A 在左,B 在右。
A 完成蓄力,摆出戏剧性的双手持刀架势。一道高耸的青色气焰自刀身升起,但没有攻击离刃而出。
B 平静地将空手相互轻拍一次,面露满足。
A 望向被击败的队列,自信的神情渐渐消退。
刀在巨大的发光气焰内部保持原状。
音乐停止。保留安静的蓄力嗡鸣与远处的废墟余响。
12.5–15.0s — 那张熟悉的脸
A 的正面特写,严格参考原画的脸部与发型。
睁大的眼睛、缩小的瞳孔、上扬的眉毛;嘴唇张开一次并保持不动。重现她那种熟悉的、茫然无措的表情。
她望向镜头方向。无脸红、无哭泣、无尖叫表情。
刀身仍释放终结技的淡淡青光照亮她的脸。
短暂推镜;定格最后一整秒。在不释放攻击、不追加笑点的情况下,以 A 的画面收尾。

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic documentary sequence depicting the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza, as if the footage was secretly captured on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. The entire video should feel like authentic recovered historical footage—not a polished modern film.

0–5s — Establishing Shot
Handheld DV-camera footage opens on the enormous Giza construction site at sunrise. Hundreds of workers move across a vast sandy landscape while the unfinished pyramid dominates the background. Wooden scaffolding, ramps, ropes, sledges, stone blocks, dust and activity fill the frame. Slight camera shake, imperfect autofocus, low-resolution DV texture, natural exposure shifts and subtle lens flare create genuine early-2000s documentary realism.

5–10s — Moving Through the Workers
The camera operator walks closer through the construction site. Workers strain together to pull a massive limestone block along a wooden sled while others shout instructions and coordinate the ropes. Sand kicks up around their feet. The camera briefly struggles to focus as people pass directly in front of the lens, making the footage feel spontaneous and unscripted.

10–16s — The Construction Process
A closer handheld shot reveals workers hauling enormous stone blocks up a massive earthen ramp toward the rising pyramid. Wooden rollers, ropes, crude tools and temporary structures surround them. Sweat, dust and exhaustion are visible on their faces. The camera pans upward, revealing the staggering scale of the unfinished monument.

16–22s — Human Moment
The footage moves into a crowded work area. A group of workers pauses briefly beside a freshly positioned limestone block, breathing heavily and covered in dust. One worker looks directly into the camera for a moment before returning to work. Behind him, dozens of others continue the construction, creating a powerful sense of scale and human effort.

22–27s — Epic Reveal
The camera slowly backs away and rises slightly, revealing the immense pyramid under construction, surrounded by thousands of workers, ramps and organized building activity. Golden sunlight cuts through airborne dust, creating natural volumetric rays. The unfinished structure feels monumental and almost overwhelming.

27–30s — Documentary Ending
The camera turns toward the pyramid’s upper levels as workers continue moving stones against the glowing sky. The operator lowers the camera slightly; the image becomes shaky and briefly overexposed by the sun. End abruptly like an authentic recovered DV recording.

Visual Direction: Ultra-realistic ancient Egypt, physically accurate materials and human movement, authentic limestone, sand, wood and rope, natural sunlight, realistic dust and sweat, practical construction methods, documentary camerawork, imperfect handheld movement, early-2000s DV compression, interlacing artifacts, subtle digital noise, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, realistic motion blur, muted natural colors and imperfect framing.

Overall Tone: Grounded, immersive and historically believable. It should feel like someone genuinely stood inside the construction site and accidentally captured a once-in-history moment—not like a modern Hollywood recreation.

16–22秒 — 人文时刻
镜头进入一个拥挤的工作区域。一群工人刚刚安放好一块新的石灰岩块，短暂地停下来喘气，浑身覆满尘土。其中一名工人短暂地直视镜头片刻，然后继续工作。在他身后，数十名其他人继续施工，营造出强烈的尺度感与人类努力的氛围。

摄像机缓缓后退并略微升高，揭示出正在建造中的巨大金字塔，周围是数千名工人、斜坡与有组织的建筑活动。金色的阳光穿透空气中飘浮的尘埃，形成自然的体积光。结构未完工却令人感到宏伟，几乎令人窒息。

Across the road are modern cream and tan apartment blocks with balconies and a rounded corner facade, a low green hedge and a small blue street sign. The sky is bright blue with large white cumulus clouds and fills the upper half of the frame.

Camera and lens: phone main lens, about 24–26mm full-frame equivalent, placed about 1.1 m high and tilted slightly upward, so building verticals converge toward the top of the frame. Deep focus: everything is sharp at every distance.

Lighting: hard, bright afternoon sunlight with crisp shadows on the pavers, phone HDR, saturated colors, deep blue sky.

Performance style: a completely deadpan, expressionless face with a wide-eyed stare into the lens throughout. All hand movements are small, precise, sharp and mechanical, locked to the beat of the music, with light rhythmic knee bounces. "Right hand" means the character's own right hand, which appears on screen left while they face the camera.

Choreography, beat by beat:
0.0–0.8 s: Extreme close-up. The character stands about 40 cm from the lens, chest and shoulders filling the frame, top of the head cropped. They stare down into the lens, motionless.
0.8–2.3 s: They walk straight backward to a mark about 3 m from the camera, touching their collar with the right hand around 1.3 s, then letting their arms settle at their sides. They are centered, framed from head to mid-shin.
2.4–3.2 s: Both hands rise to chest height, palms facing the chest, fingers spread, fingertips wiggling. The fingertips turn to point toward each other, and the hands meet at the center of the chest by 3.2 s.
3.3–4.1 s: Both index fingers point forward with the hands stacked at the center of the chest, the fingers making small twirling circles around each other.
4.1–4.5 s: The hands sink to the belly, then drop straight down to the sides.
4.6–5.2 s: Both arms swing stiffly outward to about 35 degrees from the body, palms down and fingers spread like a penguin, while the character takes one step toward the camera.
5.3–5.6 s: The right forearm swings horizontally across the belly while the left arm hangs, and the hands meet at the waist.
5.6–6.2 s: The arms drop loose, the body sways toward screen right, and the character steps back to their mark.
6.3–7.2 s: Fists come up. They crank alternately at chest and belly height, then stack knuckle-to-knuckle in front of the sternum and twist as if wringing a towel.
7.3–10.2 s: A hand-over-hand rope-pull, about two swaps per second. One fist rises to the chin while the other drops to the waist, then they swap, with the torso leaning slightly toward screen left and small head tilts. At 9.0 s both forearms stack horizontally across the chest with elbows high. At 9.3 s the fists stack in front of the chin; at 9.5 s the palms clasp together at the chest. Then the rope-pull resumes until 10.2 s.
10.3 s: A quick knee dip; the whole body drops slightly.
10.5–11.0 s: The hands hover at the chest with palms facing each other, one above the other, then turn flat and roll around each other horizontally.
11.2–11.8 s: Both fists rise to the collar with elbows out, as if gripping lapels.
12.0–12.2 s: A sharp torso twist toward screen left with the head dipping and the right arm swinging down across the body. The torso then snaps back, right arm at the hip.
12.3–12.9 s: The hands roll around each other at waist height, ending crossed at the wrists.
13.0–13.3 s: The character side-steps to the right third of the frame and turns their body about 60 degrees to face screen left.
13.3–18.0 s: An old-timey bare-knuckle boxer stance in 3/4 profile facing screen left. Both fists are raised in front of the chest, left fist forward, rolling in small vertical circles. Short jabs go toward screen left, and at 13.6 s and 16.5 s both arms extend fully toward screen left. The character bobs and ducks, dipping low at 14.8 s and 17.5 s, knees bouncing, head turned so the eyes stay on the lens, lips pursed. Meanwhile a white hatchback crosses the road behind from right to left (14.0–14.7 s), and a white SUV crosses from left to right (15.3–16.5 s).
18.0–18.4 s: The guard drops and the character turns to face the camera.
18.4–19.2 s: They walk toward the camera to about 1.5 m, framed waist-up, with the head slightly tilted and a blank stare.
19.2–19.4 s: They step back to about 2.5 m, arms at their sides.
19.5–20.5 s: Alternating index-finger points at the lens, right hand then left, jabbing forward about twice per second.
20.6–21.3 s: They walk straight toward the lens.
21.3–21.9 s: Chest-up close-up, face filling the upper frame, a slight sway.
22.0–22.4 s: The character shifts slightly toward screen right while swinging the right arm up.
22.4–23.9 s: Held pose. The right upper arm is raised with the elbow pointing screen left at head height, and the forearm bends back so a loose fist rests just above and behind the head. The head tilts toward screen right, the eyes cut sideways to the lens, and the body sways slightly.
23.9–24.6 s: The arm drops and the character leans in and slightly down toward the lens until the frame crops at the nose. The clip ends on pursed lips in the upper part of the frame.

Physics: grounded, natural body weight. Knee bounces compress into the pavement, hair sways slightly and settles with head movement, and clothing creases at the elbows and shoulders and shifts with the torso. Movement is quick and rhythmic, never floaty.

Image look: real smartphone footage, digitally sharp, phone HDR, natural wide-lens perspective distortion at close range, no film grain, no cinematic color grade, no shallow depth of field.

Constraints: no camera movement, no cuts, no slow motion, no extra people, no smiling or exaggerated facial animation, no deviation from the character reference, no copying of the reference video's performer, no morphing of hands or face, no mirrored screen direction.

竖屏 9:16 智能手机视频，一段连续不断的 24.6 秒长镜头，无剪辑，根据所上传参考视频中的歌曲编排动作。仅使用所上传参考音乐的音频轨道和音乐节拍。表演者是所提供的角色参考 @image1 中的角色。需精准匹配其面部、头发、身体比例、服装和配饰，并在每一个镜头中——从极近特写到全身——保持完全一致。

看起来像一部在阳光明媚的欧洲城市街角、用支在人行道矮墙上的手机拍摄的随性 TikTok 舞蹈视频。整段镜头中相机完全锁定，零运镜：无平移、无俯仰、无变焦、无手持抖动。构图的变化仅因为表演者向镜头走近或走远。

地点：宽阔的人行道由赤陶色和鲑鱼色方形地砖铺成，灰色盲道条通向表演者身后的白色斑马线。画面左侧三分之一处有一根灰色金属标志杆，其后方是高大的街灯。街对面是现代化的米色与浅褐色公寓楼，带阳台和圆角立面，楼下有一排低矮的绿色树篱和一块蓝色小街牌。天空呈明亮的蓝色，飘着大朵的白色积云，占据画面上半部分。

相机与镜头：手机主镜头，约 24–26mm 全画幅等效焦距，置于约 1.1 米高度并略微仰拍，因此建筑的垂直线向画面顶部汇聚。深焦：无论远近一切都保持清晰。

光线：强烈、明亮的午后阳光，地砖上有锐利的阴影，手机 HDR，色彩饱和，天空深蓝。

表演风格：全程面无表情、完全冷脸，双眼睁大直盯镜头。所有手部动作小巧、精准、干脆且机械化，严格卡在音乐节拍上，伴随轻微有节奏的膝盖弹动。"右手"指角色自身的右手，在其面向镜头时出现在画面左侧。

逐拍舞蹈编排：
0.0–0.8 秒：极近特写。角色距镜头约 40 厘米，胸部与肩膀填满画面，头顶被裁出。他们向下直盯镜头，一动不动。
0.8–2.3 秒：他们径直后退到距相机约 3 米处的标记点，约 1.3 秒时用右手触碰衣领，然后让双臂自然垂落身侧。角色居中，从头部到小腿中部入画。
2.4–3.2 秒：双手抬至胸前高度，掌心朝向胸部，手指张开，指尖轻颤。指尖转为相对，在 3.2 秒时双手在胸部中央合拢。
3.3–4.1 秒：双手食指向前指出，双手叠在胸部中央，手指相互绕着小圈旋转。
4.1–4.5 秒：双手沉至腹部，然后径直垂落到身侧。
4.6–5.2 秒：双臂僵硬地向外张开至约 35 度角，掌心向下，手指张开如企鹅状，同时角色向镜头迈进一步。
5.3–5.6 秒：右前臂水平横扫过腹部，左臂垂下，双手在腰部会合。
5.6–6.2 s：双臂松弛下垂，身体向画面右侧摆动，角色退回标记点。
6.3–7.2 秒：双拳抬起。在胸前和腹部高度交替摇动，然后拳对拳叠在胸骨前像拧毛巾一样扭转。
7.3–10.2 秒：手交替拉绳动作，约每秒两次交换。一拳抬至下巴，另一拳落至腰部，然后交换，躯干微微向画面左侧倾斜，头部小幅侧倾。9.0 秒时两前臂水平叠在胸前，肘部抬高。9.3 秒时双拳叠在下巴前；9.5 秒时双掌在胸前相扣。然后拉绳动作恢复至 10.2 秒。
10.3 秒：快速屈膝下蹲，整个身体轻微下沉。
10.5–11.0 秒：双手悬于胸前，掌心相对，一上一下，然后摊平水平地相互绕转。
11.2–11.8 秒：双拳抬至衣领处，肘部外张，像抓住翻领一样。
12.0–12.2 秒：躯干猛然向画面左侧扭转，头部下低，右臂向下横扫过身体。躯干随即弹回，右臂置于髋部。
12.3–12.9 秒：双手在腰部高度相互绕转，最后在手腕处交叉。
13.0–13.3 秒：角色横移至画面右侧三分之一处，身体转约 60 度面向画面左侧。
13.3–18.0 秒：面向画面左侧呈 3/4 侧面的老式裸拳拳手架势。双拳抬于胸前，左拳在前，做小幅垂直绕环。短促刺拳打向画面左侧，在 13.6 秒和 16.5 秒时双臂完全伸向画面左侧。角色上下起伏闪躲，分别在 14.8 秒和 17.5 秒时大幅下蹲，膝盖弹动，头部转动使眼睛始终盯着镜头，嘴唇撅起。同时一辆白色掀背车在背景道路上从右向左驶过（14.0–14.7 秒），一辆白色 SUV 从左向右驶过（15.3–16.5 秒）。
18.0–18.4 秒：拳架放下，角色转身面向镜头。
18.4–19.2 秒：他们向镜头走来至约 1.5 米处，腰部以上入画，头部微微倾斜，面无表情。
19.2–19.4 秒：他们退回至约 2.5 米处，双臂垂于身侧。
19.5–20.5 秒：交替用食指指向镜头，右手先左手后，以约每秒两次的频率向前戳出。
20.6–21.3 秒：他们径直向镜头走来。
21.3–21.9 秒：胸部以上特写，面部填充画面上半部分，轻微摇摆。
22.0–22.4 秒：角色微微向画面右侧移动，同时挥起右臂。
22.4–23.9 秒：定格姿势。右上臂抬起，肘部指向画面左侧至头部高度，前臂向后弯折，使松握的拳头停在头部正上方略偏后。头部向画面右侧倾斜，眼角斜瞥镜头，身体轻微摇摆。
23.9–24.6 秒：手臂放下，角色前倾并微微向下朝向镜头，直到画面裁切至鼻部。镜头在画面上方的撅嘴表情上结束。

物理效果：贴地、真实的体重感。膝盖弹动压缩至地面，头发随头部动作轻微摆动后落定，服装在肘部和肩部产生褶皱并随躯干移动。动作快速而有节奏，绝不飘忽。

画面质感：真实智能手机拍摄，画面数字化锐利，手机 HDR，近距离自然广角透视畸变，无胶片颗粒，无电影感调色，无浅景深。

限制条件：无运镜，无剪辑，无慢动作，无额外人物，无微笑或夸张面部表情，不得偏离角色参考，不得复制参考视频中的表演者，手部和面部不得变形，画面方向不得镜像。

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic horror-action short film set aboard a crowded Japanese commuter train during late afternoon. Begin with an immediate high-impact hook at full speed. The story must remain coherent, physically grounded, and easy to follow, with clear cause-and-effect between every shot.

FORMAT & VISUAL STYLE

- Duration: 30 seconds
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 cinematic widescreen
- Photorealistic cinematic realism
- Grounded practical-effects style
- Authentic Japanese commuter train interior
- Muted natural daylight color grading
- Realistic skin texture, clothing, reflections and materials
- No subtitles
- No text overlays
- No watermark
- No logos or unnecessary graphics

CHARACTER CONTINUITY

Maintain consistent characters throughout:

- One female passenger wearing a beige coat
- One male passenger wearing a dark business suit
- A female train attendant wearing a navy railway uniform
- A male train operator seen briefly inside the front cabin
- Multiple background passengers filling the train

Keep identical faces, hairstyles, clothing, body proportions and appearance throughout the sequence.

SEQUENCE — 30 SECONDS

[0–1s] — THE HOOK

Hard cut to an extreme close-up of a woman's hand gripping a train seat. Her fingers suddenly tighten violently. Her breathing becomes rapid and irregular as the train continues moving at full speed.

[1–2s] — SOMETHING IS WRONG

Close-up of her face. Tiny dark veins rapidly appear beneath the skin around her eyes and neck. She suddenly looks toward the passenger beside her.

[2–3s] — FIRST ATTACK

She violently lunges across the narrow aisle and grabs the suited man's shoulder. He cries out as nearby passengers recoil. The camera jolts with the sudden movement.

[3–4s] — PANIC

Handheld close shot. The man struggles to push her away while passengers stand and move toward the opposite end of the carriage. Seats shake and overhead straps swing from the disturbance.

[4–5s] — SECOND INFECTION

Extreme close-up of the man's neck. Dark vascular patterns rapidly spread beneath his skin. His expression changes from confusion to terror.

[5–6s] — THEY TURN

The infected woman releases him. He suddenly stands beside her. Both slowly turn toward the surrounding passengers as the train continues racing through the city.

[6–7s] — CHAOS

Wide handheld shot down the carriage. Passengers scream and push toward the connecting door. Someone drops a bag. A drink spills across the floor as the train rocks through a curve.

[7–8s] — THE ATTENDANT REACTS

Whip-pan toward the female train attendant. She sees the infected passengers approaching and immediately grabs the emergency communication handset.

She urgently shouts in Japanese:

「次の駅で緊急停止してください！」

[8–9s] — EMERGENCY BRAKING

Cut to the front cabin. The train operator reacts immediately, pulling the emergency brake control. Warning lights illuminate as the train begins decelerating.

[9–10s] — THE IMPACT OF STOPPING

Low-angle tracking shot along the carriage floor. Passengers stumble forward as the train brakes violently. Handrails swing and luggage shifts from overhead racks.

[10–11s] — EMERGENCY EXIT

The train comes to a hard stop at a station platform. The attendant forces open the emergency door mechanism and gestures for passengers to move outside.

[11–12s] — ESCAPE

Wide shot. Passengers rapidly pour onto the platform. The attendant keeps one arm extended, directing everyone away from the carriage.

[12–13s] — THE INFECTED FOLLOW

Low-angle shot from the platform. The two infected passengers burst through the train doorway after the fleeing crowd.

[13–14s] — THE LAST DEFENSE

The attendant grabs a heavy emergency flashlight from the train's safety cabinet and positions herself between the infected passengers and the remaining civilians.

[14–15s] — FIRST STRIKE

Fast side-tracking shot. One infected passenger lunges. The attendant sidesteps and uses the heavy flashlight to knock the attacker backward.

[15–16s] — SECOND ATTACK

The male infected charges from the opposite direction. A railway maintenance worker rushes into frame and blocks him with a large metal safety barrier.

[16–17s] — SLOW MOTION

SLOW MOTION INSERT. The female infected lunges again. The attendant pivots and strikes her shoulder with the flashlight, sending her stumbling onto the platform.

[17–18s] — FALL

Real-time. The infected woman crashes onto the platform and rolls several feet before coming to a stop.

[18–19s] — COUNTERATTACK

The male infected pushes the metal barrier aside and charges the maintenance worker. He braces himself and drives the barrier forward.

[19–20s] — IMPACT

The barrier slams into the infected passenger, forcing him backward against a station pillar. The camera shakes naturally from the impact.

[20–21s] — FINAL TAKEDOWN

The attendant rushes in and strikes the infected passenger's legs with the flashlight while the maintenance worker keeps the barrier pressed forward.

[21–22s] — SILENCE

Both infected lie motionless on the platform. The attendant and maintenance worker remain alert, breathing heavily and watching for movement.

[22–24s] — SURVIVORS

Wide cinematic shot. Passengers gather farther down the platform, frightened but safe. The train doors remain open behind them while station staff begin securing the area.

[24–26s] — CHECKING THE THREAT

Medium tracking shot. The attendant cautiously approaches the two fallen infected and watches them carefully. The maintenance worker remains beside her.

[26–28s] — A MOMENT OF RELIEF

Close-up on the attendant's exhausted face. Her breathing slowly settles. She looks toward the passengers and sees that they are safe.

[28–30s] — FINAL TWIST

Slow controlled push-in toward the male infected lying on the platform.

Everything appears still.

Then his fingers twitch once.

The attendant notices the movement.

Her expression changes instantly.

Cut sharply to black.

AUDIO

Natural diegetic sound throughout:

- Train wheels and rail vibration
- Passenger conversations and sudden screams
- Heavy breathing
- Emergency announcement sounds
- Braking screeches
- Bags and objects falling
- Train doors opening
- Footsteps on the platform
- Metal impacts
- Distant station ambience

A tense cinematic score begins immediately, intensifies during the outbreak and escape, becomes aggressive during the confrontation, then drops almost completely silent during the final finger movement.

CAMERA REQUIREMENTS

Use maximum dynamic but physically believable camera variety:

- Extreme close-ups
- Handheld tracking
- Low-angle floor shots
- Wide carriage compositions
- Whip pans
- Platform-level tracking
- Controlled push-ins
- Overhead perspective during the evacuation
- Realistic camera shake only during braking and physical impacts

Slow motion is used only for the designated takedown at 16–17 seconds.

Maintain strong spatial continuity. Characters must move logically through the train and onto the platform. Avoid random actions, unnecessary cuts, impossible camera positions, excessive gore, exaggerated body movement, cartoon physics, or additional creatures.

FINAL OUTPUT: 30-second, 16:9, photorealistic Japanese horror-action short film with grounded practical effects, coherent storytelling, realistic human movement, cinematic camera work, natural daylight, immersive sound design, no watermark, no subtitles, and no text overlays.

概念："雨天下午跑腿"
制作一段 15 秒的模拟家庭录像，使用手持 Hi8/VH…

Concept: "Rainy Afternoon Errand"
Create an authentic 15-second analogue home-video recording filmed with a handheld Hi8/VHS-C camcorder. The camcorder is never visible. The audience only sees the recorded footage, as if watching a digitized family videotape. This is not a vlog, commercial, or cinematic production—just a friend casually filming another friend during an ordinary day.
Use authentic analogue camcorder aesthetics: soft SD resolution, subtle VHS tape grain, faint interlacing, analogue colour bleed, mild tracking imperfections, slight autofocus hunting, natural handheld shake, tiny framing errors, realistic motion blur, washed-out colours, and faint tape hiss. Avoid HDR, beauty filters, cinematic grading, perfect stabilization, or modern digital sharpness.
A young Korean woman in her early twenties wears a fitted pastel crop top, mid-rise vintage blue denim shorts, white ankle socks, classic white sneakers, and a lightweight oversized windbreaker tied around her waist. She carries a small canvas shoulder bag, and her appearance reflects a nostalgic late-90s/early-2000s Korean street style without referencing any specific year.
The scene takes place on a quiet residential street after a light summer rain. The pavement is still damp, small puddles reflect nearby buildings, bicycles are parked outside shops, neighbours walk by with umbrellas, and local cafés and convenience stores create a peaceful everyday atmosphere.
The footage begins as she exits a small neighbourhood convenience store carrying a drink and a paper shopping bag. She pauses under the awning, looks up at the cloudy sky, and smiles as a light drizzle begins again. She playfully extends her hand to feel a few raindrops before noticing the unseen camera operator. She laughs, gives a friendly wave, briefly twirls once in the drizzle, then continues walking down the wet street. The camera follows naturally behind as reflections shimmer on the pavement and a city bus quietly passes in the background. The recording ends naturally as she disappears farther down the street.
Generation Requirements
Produce one continuous 15-second recording with no cuts or transitions. Maintain consistent identity, realistic anatomy, natural walking, authentic human expressions, believable interactions, and physically accurate rain effects. Include realistic ambient sounds such as soft rain, distant traffic, birds, footsteps on wet pavement, and neighbourhood ambience. Avoid AI artifacts, duplicated pedestrians, warped anatomy, floating objects, modern cinematic effects, or anything that reveals the footage as AI-generated. The final result should feel indistinguishable from a genuine nostalgic analogue home video recorded by a friend.

概念："雨天下午跑腿"
制作一段 15 秒的模拟家庭录像，使用手持 Hi8/VHS-C 摄像机拍摄的真实质感画面。摄像机本身始终不出现。观众只看到录制下来的画面，仿佛在观看一盘翻录成数字版的家庭录像带。这不是 vlog、广告或电影制作——只是一个朋友在平常日子里随意地拍另一位朋友。
使用真实的模拟摄像机美学：柔和的标清分辨率、细微的 VHS 磁带颗粒、淡淡的隔行扫描纹、模拟色彩溢出、轻微的磁迹跟踪瑕疵、轻微的自动对焦抖动、自然的手持晃动、细微的取景误差、真实的运动模糊、褪色的色彩，以及微弱的磁带底噪。避免 HDR、美颜滤镜、电影感调色、完美的稳定效果或现代数字锐度。
一位二十出头的年轻韩国女性，穿着一件合身的柔和色短款上衣、中腰复古蓝色牛仔短裤、白色踝袜、经典白色运动鞋，腰间系着一件轻薄的宽松风衣外套。她背着一个帆布小肩包，整体造型带有怀旧的 90 年代末/00 年代初韩国街头风格，但不指明具体年份。
场景设定在夏季小雨过后的安静住宅街道。人行道仍是湿的，小水洼倒映着附近的建筑，商店外停着自行车，邻居们撑着伞走过，本地的咖啡馆和便利店营造出宁静的日常生活氛围。
画面开始时，她从一家社区小便利店走出，手里拿着一杯饮料和一个纸质购物袋。她在雨棚下停下脚步，抬头望向阴云密布的天空，当小雨再次开始时露出微笑。她俏皮地伸出手感受了几滴雨点，然后注意到了未入镜的拍摄者。她笑了起来，友好地挥了挥手，在细雨中短暂地转了一圈，然后继续沿着湿漉漉的街道走去。镜头自然地跟在身后，人行道上的倒影闪烁，背景中一辆城市公交车静静地经过。当她渐渐消失在街道远处时，录像自然结束。
生成要求
制作一段连续的 15 秒录像，无剪辑无转场。保持一致的人物身份、真实的解剖结构、自然的步态、真实的人类表情、可信的互动以及物理上准确的雨效。包含真实的环境音，例如轻柔的雨声、远处的车流、鸟鸣、踩在湿人行道上的脚步声和街区环境音。避免 AI 伪影、重复的行人、扭曲的解剖、漂浮的物体、现代电影感效果，或任何暴露画面为 AI 生成的内容。最终成品应让人无法分辨与朋友拍摄的真正怀旧模拟家庭录像的差别。

场景与镜头
一个连贯的现代美式办公室：入口 → 安保台 → 门禁闸机 → 玻璃走…

SETTING & CAMERA
One continuous modern American office: entrance → security desk → badge gate → glass corridor → open office → whiteboard aisle → Jessica’s desk. Morning light, hard floors, realistic office furniture. A white PTZ security camera is already mounted above/right of her desk and must remain there throughout.

0–25.5s: continuous third-person tracking, usually 1.5m behind Jessica’s right shoulder. Realistic follow-lag, whip-pans to threats, no hidden cuts or teleportation.
25.5s: hard cut to fixed frontal medium close-up showing Jessica, her desk, and the PTZ camera.

HUD: Minimap bottom-left; STAMINA/COMPOSURE top-left; DETECTION top-center; SPRINT/CROUCH/INTERACT/SLIDE bottom-right. Opening: “LATE — 12 MIN” / “OBJECTIVE: REACH YOUR DESK UNDETECTED.”

0–7s — SECURITY GUARD

Jessica sprints through the entrance with her bag. The guard notices her. She hides behind a large planter instead of confronting him, dropping low as he approaches with his radio. Detection rises 58% → 91%. When he looks away, she quietly slips out, badges through the gate, and continues. The guard notices the closing gate but does not chase. Detection falls to 34%.

7–13s — HR CART

HR pushes a tall cart loaded with folders toward Jessica. She accidentally brushes the glass, then quickly crouches behind the cart and moves with it, staying hidden as HR checks both sides. She circles behind the cart when HR looks away, then breaks cover and runs once the corridor is clear. HR never clearly sees her. Detection peaks at 96%, then drops to 40%.

13–18s — DEPARTMENT HEAD DISCOVERY

The department head appears at a T-junction and notices Jessica's reflection through the glass. He turns toward her. A large solid-red “!” flashes exactly twice above him. Only afterward, DETECTION turns red: “ALERT.” He calls, “Hey! Hold on!” Jessica turns and says, “Oh, crap!” He follows her route.

18–23.5s — WHITEBOARD ESCAPE

Jessica races through the open-office aisle, grabs a wheeled whiteboard, and pulls it diagonally across his path. He brakes before hitting it and immediately circles around. Jessica squeezes through the remaining gap between the whiteboard and desk using a low side-slide, keeping her bag tight to her body, then immediately gets up and runs. He remains behind her.

23.5–25.5s — FALSE SUCCESS

Jessica reaches her desk, drops into the chair, puts the bag underneath, and starts typing while catching her breath. The department head searches the rear aisle but cannot see her. DETECTION falls to 0%. Green “MISSION COMPLETE” appears. Jessica smiles with relief.

25.5–30s — CCTV TWIST

At 26.2s, the pre-installed PTZ camera physically whirs, pans and tilts toward Jessica, then its red indicator illuminates. She slowly looks up toward it and freezes. Remove “MISSION COMPLETE.” Show “CCTV DETECTED”, followed by red “MISSION FAILED.” She mutters, “You've got to be kidding me.” Hold her defeated expression, the red-lit camera, and failure HUD until the end.

PHYSICS & RESTRICTIONS
Real footsteps, shoe friction, breathing, bag movement, glass reflections, radio, badge gate, cart/whiteboard/chair wheels, keyboard sounds, and PTZ motor. No teleportation, clipping, frictionless movement, clones, identity changes, distorted hands, plastic skin, impossible reflections, or furniture hitting people. Only the department head pursues Jessica. The guard and HR associate never chase her. The CCTV camera must physically turn; the HUD must not replace the physical camera action.

场景与镜头
一个连贯的现代美式办公室：入口 → 安保台 → 门禁闸机 → 玻璃走廊 → 开放办公区 → 白板过道 → Jessica 的工位。晨光、硬质地地板、写实的办公家具。一台白色 PTZ 安防摄像头已预装在她工位的上方/右侧，且全程必须保持在那里。

0–25.5 秒：持续的第三人称跟踪，通常位于 Jessica 右肩后方 1.5 米。写实的跟随延迟、对威胁的快速甩镜摇移，禁止隐藏剪辑或瞬移。
25.5 秒：硬切到固定的正面中近景，同时呈现 Jessica、她的工位以及 PTZ 摄像头。

HUD：左下角小地图；左上角 STAMINA/COMPOSURE（体力/镇定）；顶部居中 DETECTION（侦测度）；右下角 SPRINT/CROUCH/INTERACT/SLIDE（冲刺/蹲下/互动/滑铲）。开场文字：“LATE — 12 MIN”（迟到 — 12 分钟） / “OBJECTIVE: REACH YOUR DESK UNDETECTED.”（目标：在不被发现的情况下到达你的工位。）

0–7 秒 — 安保人员

Jessica 拎着包冲进入口。安保人员注意到了她。她没有正面交锋，而是躲到一个大型花盆后面，随着他拿着对讲机靠近而压低身形。侦测度由 58% 上升至 91%。当他移开视线时，她悄悄溜出，刷工牌通过闸机继续前进。安保人员注意到了正在关闭的闸机，但并未追赶。侦测度回落至 34%。

7–13 秒 — HR 手推车

HR 推着一辆装满文件夹的高推车朝 Jessica 走来。她不小心蹭到了玻璃，随后迅速蹲到推车后方并随车一起前行，在 HR 两边查看时始终保持隐藏。当 HR 移开视线后，她绕到推车后方，待走廊清空后脱离掩体并奔跑逃离。HR 从未清楚地看到过她。侦测度峰值达到 96%，随后下降至 40%。

13–18 秒 — 部门主管发现

部门主管出现在一个 T 字路口，并通过玻璃看到了 Jessica 的倒影。他转身面向她。一个大号纯红色“!”标识在他头顶正上方恰好闪烁两次。仅在此之后，DETECTION 变红显示：“ALERT”（警报）。他喊道：“Hey! Hold on!”（嘿！站住！）Jessica 转头说：“Oh, crap!”（糟糕！）并沿着她的路线继续追赶。

18–23.5 秒 — 白板脱身

Jessica 冲过开放办公区过道，抓起一辆带轮白板，将其斜向拉到他的行进路线上。他在撞到白板前急刹车，并立刻绕行。Jessica 通过一个低位侧滑从白板与工位之间的剩余缝隙中挤过去，同时将包紧贴身体，随后立刻起身奔跑。他依然落在她身后。

23.5–25.5 秒 — 虚假成功

Jessica 到达工位，一屁股坐到椅子上，把包塞到桌子下面，一边喘气一边开始打字。部门主管在后侧过道搜索，但无法看到她。DETECTION 下降至 0%。绿色 “MISSION COMPLETE”（任务完成）字样出现。Jessica 如释重负地露出微笑。

25.5–30 秒 — CCTV 反转

在 26.2 秒时，预装的 PTZ 摄像头物理性地发出嗡鸣声，旋转并俯仰对准她，随后其红色指示灯亮起。她缓缓抬头看向摄像头并僵在原地。移除 “MISSION COMPLETE”。显示 “CCTV DETECTED”（CCTV 已侦测），随后显示红色 “MISSION FAILED”（任务失败）。她低声嘟囔：“You've got to be kidding me.”（开什么玩笑。）一直保持她挫败的表情、泛红光的摄像头，以及失败状态的 HUD 直至结束。

物理效果与限制
真实的脚步声、鞋底摩擦、呼吸、包具摆动、玻璃反光、对讲机、门禁闸机、推车/白板/椅子滚轮、键盘声以及 PTZ 马达声。禁止瞬移、穿模、无摩擦运动、克隆体、身份变更、手部变形、塑料感皮肤、不可能的反射，或家具撞人。只有部门主管会追 Jessica。安保人员和 HR 同事绝不会追她。CCTV 摄像头必须物理性地转动；HUD 不得替代摄像头的物理动作。
